snippet.title: Tiny Dwellings - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Tiny Dwellings is a calm, creative pixel-art builder where you can make tiny cosy spaces at your own pace.

Place furniture, decorate rooms, add plants and props, play with lighting, and unwind in a relaxing lo-fi atmosphere. With over 1,000 items to choose from, Tiny Dwellings is all about the simple joy of building something cute, cosy and entirely your own.

No timers. No stress. Just tiny homes, soft ambience and satisfying creative play.

Wishlist Tiny Dwellings on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4531250/Tiny_Dwellings 

Follow Tiny Dwellings:
X / Twitter: https://x.com/tinydwellings
